title: i love it
body: i dont usually do reviews but this app rlly deserves a 5-star one. its such a simple yet very useful app to form routines!! the interface and design of the app is also really cute, minimal and easy to use :) there are many features i rlly like such as; u can use other apps (play music, read online books, etc) while ur routine still goes on in the background…then when ur routine is done, it gives u a notification thats very soothing like “ur routine is done, but take ur time”. another thing i like is, even when ur routine is done but ure not done, it allows u to snooze..giving u more time to complete ur routine. it also tracks how long u took to complete a habit/routine which is SO GREAT!!! i HIGHLY recommend u to try this app out :) big thank u to the developers for creating this free app!!!
